projects.name: From concept to shipped AI product
projects.description: Led a team of three through product discovery and six rapid product-vision iterations to ship an AI developer-tools product, and set up an AI-assisted workflow that speeds up every delivery cycle.

projects.name: A government-grade platform, delivered
projects.description: Led planning, design and delivery of three projects, including a multi-tenant platform where every region runs as a legally separate entity, with faster responses on the busiest requests.

projects.name: Turning around a stalled e-commerce business
projects.description: Resolved a year-long deadlock between a national clothing franchise and its development agency, took over the infrastructure and migrated the store to a platform the business could rely on.

projects.name: Co-founding and shipping a product
projects.description: Co-founded the company and built its role-based platform and mobile apps, making the product feel instant and catching crashes before users report them.

projects.name: ResNet-18 accuracy at a hundredth of the size
projects.description: Designed a 97K-parameter network for small, class-imbalanced medical datasets. It matches or beats the ResNet-18 benchmark on all six MedMNIST tasks with about a hundredth of the parameters, and stays accurate where published lightweight networks lose up to eight AUC points.

projects.name: Accurate models from a few hundred images
projects.description: Built an 82K-parameter network whose first stage is constructed before training instead of learned, so it needs no pretrained weights and beats every from-scratch baseline on every seed across three medical tasks.

projects.name: Catching a flaw standard metrics hide
projects.description: Ran a five-factor ablation across four medical tasks showing that a common classifier-head design misgrades diabetic retinopathy further along the severity scale, a harm invisible to F1 and AUC, and that a single linear classifier matches heads 743× its size.

projects.name: Reviving a stalled patent project
projects.description: Completed a computer-vision project that had stalled for two years, with a homography-free marker detection algorithm fast enough for real time.

projects.name: Dive Club
projects.description: Automated regional swimming competitions, making results more transparent and accurate.

projects.name: Death Note
projects.description: An AI-driven web experience built on OpenAI and DALL·E for the Convex / WebDevCody hackathon.

projects.name: Agritech
projects.description: Digitized organization and participant management for a national university seminar with a dedicated app and website.
